newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai official sees bumpy bourse until after polls.
newsitem.headline: Thai official sees bumpy bourse until after polls.

text.p: The battered Thai stock market is likely to remain volatile until a new government is formed after general elections on November 17, a senior Finance Ministry official said on Tuesday.
The ministry's permanent secretary, Chatumongkol Sonakul, told reporters that there was in the interim period an absence of continuity in Thai economic and political spheres.

This had hit foreign investor confidence in the market, which dived on Monday to over three-year lows on heavy foreign sales, especially of bank stocks. The market on Tuesday was down, but not by as much as on Monday.

"Therefore, the market will fluctuate like this and lack stability until new government is formed. Investors want to see who will be in the government and what kind of economic policy it has to offer," he said.
